verdict.rationale: Skyvern's GitHub README says it maps visual elements to actions. Its llms.txt says it uses LLMs and computer vision, and a vision model is used for CAPTCHA detection. That points to screenshot-based perception as part of its core approach. However, nothing shows a distinct, developer-selectable vision or computer-use action mode, or that it works on canvases and non-DOM UIs where the DOM path fails. missing for 10: an explicit switchable vision/computer-use action mode, documentation of coordinate- or screenshot-driven actions for canvas and non-DOM UIs, hands-on corroboration of this capability.
